title: Jay Joundi Agayi Dukhi Zainab
body:
Jay Joundi Agai Dukhi Zainab
Chad Shaam Bazaran Nu
Mein samajh kay sir veeran day
ghabran day aarn kay pawangi veeran diya dastara nu
Akbar da baba, vada aye Zainab da
bekafan lasha lai
teri karbal day vich mere, athru tameer
Karan gaye, pathran day naal mazara nu
Surn aye karbobala, tere hawalay hurn,
kar ke turpai zainab
Tenu qasam meri chadar di, rakhi naal
araam de goud de vich, mere veer de
khidmat garan nu
Vekh kay ghazi de, sir nay aabid val,
bhen izkita aye,
Afsous menu reh jaana, mere qaatil ne
rangeen keetha, Teri bhen dhe yaan
rukhsara nu
